segments.source: Three Africas is the clearest current Blue Bottle whole-bean route to a fruit-led cold brew: the roaster explicitly describes the blend cold-brewed, and its 2026 page identifies washed and natural Ethiopian coffees with a Rwandan component. Choose it when raisin, blueberry and citrus sound welcome rather than when you want an anonymous cocoa-only concentrate. Coffeedant has not brewed or tasted the current bag.
